HotelName: Clarion Hotel & Convention Center Atlantic City West
Description:
HotelDescription#This city and conference hotel is located just 1.6 km from the Shore Mall and 9.6 km from Atlantic City outlet shopping at 'The Walk'. The establishment is a 30-minute walk from the city centre and is 3.2 km from the Story Book Land amusement park. The Atlantic Ocean is a 20-minute drive away and there guests will find a number of casinos. Atlantic City Convention Center is some 8 km from the establishment.

This suburban shore hotel was built in 1984 and underwent renovation in 2008. It is a 6-storey building that comprises a total of 213 guest rooms and suites. Whether travelling for business or leisure, guests will find that this hotel has great amenities and a very knowledgeable staff. Fully air-conditioned, the establishment welcomes its guests into a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service and a hotel safe. Lift access, a games room, a TV lounge and a bar and restaurant all feature. Conference facilities and WLAN Internet access can also be found on site and room and laundry services are available. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in the car park. Younger guests can let off some steam at the children's playground.

The comfortable and spacious guest rooms and suites consists of cable TV, direct dial telephones, hairdryers and tea and coffee making facilities. The en suite bathrooms are fitted with a bathtub/shower and other in-room amenities include a radio, a double bed, an ironing set and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

Guests can enjoy a swim in the outdoor fresh water swimming pool or can relax and get a tan on the sun terrace. Those wishing to play a round of golf can visit the nearest golf courses, which lie 20 minutes away by public transport or by car. The nearest beach is sandy.

Guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet and can select lunch and dinner from the set menus. An additional buffet is also served at midday.

Guests can enjoy a swim in the outdoor fresh water swimming pool or can relax and get a tan on the sun terrace. Those wishing to play a round of golf can visit the nearest golf courses, which lie 20 minutes away by public transport or by car. The nearest beach is sandy.

Guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet and can select lunch and dinner from the set menus. An additional buffet is also served at midday.
